CVS Health is hiring a Software Development Engineer - Operational Analytics to build and maintain full-stack applications supporting data-driven business solutions. The role develops frontend interfaces, backend services, and RESTful APIs, and supports application observability, testing, and deployment in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities
Assists in the design, development, and maintenance of full-stack web applications supporting data-driven business solutions
Applies understanding of key business drivers to contribute to the resolution of moderately complex problems
Leads portions of initiatives of limited scope, with guidance and direction
Builds frontend interfaces and backend services, ensuring seamless integration across systems
Collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions
Develops responsive applications and RESTful APIs using Python, TypeScript, and modern web frameworks
Supports application observability through logging, alerting, and performance monitoring
Participates in code reviews, testing, and deployment activities
